memes.name: GMGN
memes.standout: Most-used surface: New Pairs + Smart Money on Solana/Base/BSC.
bullets: Meme tracker, not a general AI chatbot.

memes.name: Pump.fun
memes.standout: Most-used surface: live Solana bonding-curve feed; Mayhem is the agent overlay.
bullets: Trend = whatever is printing on the curve right now.
Discovery at the venue, not after the fact.

memes.name: DEX Screener (New / Trending)
memes.standout: Most-used surface: chain filters on Solana, Base, and BSC New Pairs + Trending.
bullets: Best raw trend finder when a coin leaves the launchpad.
Use search by pair, not by ticker name.

memes.name: AIXBT
memes.standout: Most-used surface: @aixbt_agent narrative posts on which meme meta is heating up.
bullets: Meme-cycle radar on Crypto Twitter + flows.
Tells you the meta (animals, AI, tickers) before the tape is obvious.
Does not list every new pair.

memes.name: Cookie.fun
memes.standout: Most-used surface: mindshare leaderboard for meme tickers and agent coins.
bullets: Useful for spotting a name before volume shows up on GMGN.

memes.name: Ave.ai
memes.standout: Most-used surface: narrative tags + multi-chain meme screens.
bullets: Pairs on-chain prints with a story tag.
Good second screen next to GMGN.

memes.name: Clanker
memes.standout: Most-used surface: Base token launches from the Clanker agent.
bullets: Base meme launchpad with real fees.
Watch what it deploys, then confirm on DEX Screener.
Launcher quality varies coin to coin.

memes.name: four.meme
memes.standout: Most-used surface: BNB Chain bonding-curve launch feed.
bullets: Same job as Pump.fun, different chain.
Use when Solana meta is stale and BSC is running.

memes.name: Birdeye
memes.standout: Most-used surface: Solana trending tokens + new pools.
bullets: Chain trend finder with liquidity and holder views.
Strong after a coin graduates Pump.fun.
Weaker on Base/BSC than DEX Screener.

memes.name: Photon / BullX
memes.standout: Most-used surface: fast Solana meme terminals (new pairs + execute).
bullets: Trader-facing trend feed, not a research essay.
Discover and click through in the same UI.
